intro.h2: The handymen customers keep calling back
paragraphs: Coastal Myrtle Beach Handymen is a veteran-owned handyman service in Myrtle Beach, SC. One customer has used us several times and describes two hard-working, honest men who aim to please, price reasonably and are very personable and multitalented. Another called at the last minute, and we showed up a couple of hours later.

The work covers a lot of ground. One longtime client has had us mount complicated art pieces, install and build custom workspaces for her art studio, and change out ceiling fans and light fixtures. She calls our work ethic superior, our communication clear and timely, and our prices more than fair.

items.name: Accent walls and fireplace surrounds
items.blurb: A feature wall can anchor a whole room. The one shown here has white planks laid in a herringbone pattern, a rustic wood mantel, a built-in electric fireplace and a mounted TV, all framed between two windows. Tell us about the wall you have in mind.

image.alt: White herringbone plank feature wall with a rustic wood mantel, electric fireplace and wall-mounted TV

items.name: Art and TV mounting
items.blurb: Heavy, awkward or high up, we can hang it. Laurie G. has had us mount complicated art pieces, and the large winged heart shown here went up high on a vaulted wall above a ledge, lit from below. We settle the placement with you before anything goes up.

image.alt: Large winged heart sculpture mounted high on a dark accent wall under a vaulted ceiling, with two ladders below

items.name: Ceiling fans and light fixtures
items.blurb: Ceiling fan installation is one of the topics in our Google reviews, and one longtime client has had us change out both ceiling fans and light fixtures. Pick the fixture you like, and we will take down the old one and put the new one up.

items.name: Custom workspaces and built-ins
items.blurb: Need a place to work or create? We have installed and built custom workspaces for a client's art studio. Tell us how you work, what you need to store and how much room you have, and we will build something that fits both the space and the job.

about.text: Coastal Myrtle Beach Handymen is a veteran-owned handyman business in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Our customers describe two hard-working, honest men who are personable, multitalented and, in one client's words, a lot of fun to have around. The jobs in our reviews run from mounting complicated art and building studio workspaces to swapping ceiling fans and light fixtures, plus last-minute calls where we arrived within a couple of hours. Google lists us as open 24 hours, every day, so call whenever a job comes up and we will tell you when we can be there.

process.h2: How a job with us works

steps.title: Call any time
steps.text: Call (854) 218-3510. Google lists us as open 24 hours, so call when the job comes up, even at the last minute.

steps.title: Tell us the job
steps.text: Describe what you need mounted, installed, built or fixed. Photos of the space help us bring the right tools and parts.

steps.title: Talk through the price
steps.text: We go over the job and what it will cost before we start, so you can decide with the numbers in front of you.

steps.title: Get it done
steps.text: We show up, do the work carefully and keep you posted, the way customers describe our communication: clear and timely.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: Before we leave, we clean up after ourselves and make sure you are happy with how everything turned out.

service_area.h2: Handyman services in Myrtle Beach, SC
service_area.text: Coastal Myrtle Beach Handymen works with homeowners in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. If your home is nearby and you are not sure we cover it, call (854) 218-3510 and ask. Tell us the address and what needs doing, from a ceiling fan to an accent wall or a piece of art that needs hanging, and we will let you know whether we can help and when.

items.q: What kinds of jobs do you take on?
items.a: Our reviews cover mounting complicated art pieces, installing and building custom workspaces, changing out ceiling fans and light fixtures, and general handyman calls. Photos on our Google profile also show an accent wall with a fireplace surround and a sunroom floor. If you are not sure we do something, just ask.

items.q: Can you come out on short notice?
items.a: Often, yes. One customer called us last minute, and we showed up a couple of hours later, got the job done and cleaned up after ourselves. Google lists us as open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, so call (854) 218-3510 and we will tell you when we can come.

items.q: How do you price your work?
items.a: Customers describe our prices as reasonable and more than fair, and pricing is one of the topics that comes up most in our reviews. Tell us about the job, ideally with a photo or two, and we will talk through the cost with you before any work starts.

Yes. Coastal Myrtle Beach Handymen identifies as veteran-owned on our Google Business Profile. Customers know us as two hard-working, honest men who are personable and multitalented, and several of them have called us back for one job after another around the house.

Call (854) 218-3510 any day, at any hour, since Google lists us as open 24 hours. You can also email myrtlehandyman@gmail.com with a description of the job and a few photos, which helps us plan the visit and bring what we need.

final_cta.text: Call the Coastal Myrtle Beach Handymen, even at the last minute.
